audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart read "Skill" on five of seven rows while content win[] read Akali/Naafiri/Naafiri/Naafiri/Akali/Akali/Akali, and phases[0].side read Naafiri against win[0]=Akali.
audit.why: Packet levelChart matches win[]; the full layer was the stale copy, and row 1 flatly contradicted it.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side=Akali, [1..3]=Naafiri, [5..6]=Akali; [4] already Akali. Proposed as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes described the lane in generic terms with no cooldowns, and dosFull[2].d called Hounds' Pursuit a "fifteen-second" cooldown.
audit.why: Hounds' Pursuit is 110/95/80s. Calling it fifteen seconds inverts the entire punish window — it is the longest cooldown in her kit, not the shortest.
audit.corrected: Real numbers throughout: Darkin Daggers 9-7s at 900 range, Eviscerate 11-7s, The Call of the Pack 26-18s, Hounds' Pursuit 110-80s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three decisive interactions were never stated: Naafiri has THREE untargetable windows (W, E, R), her R recast grants a shield, and her R reveals nearby enemies on a takedown — which sees through Twilight Shroud.
audit.why: Akali's whole pattern is timed burst plus an execute plus invisibility. Untargetable blanks the execute, the recast shield eats the burst, and the reveal removes the shroud as an escape once she has a kill in the fight.
audit.corrected: Never open your R into The Call of the Pack; force the Hounds' Pursuit recast shield out before you spend your own commit; do not treat the shroud as safe after she scores a takedown.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried the boilerplate "Step up only on its downtime" tail and no numbers.
audit.why: Eviscerate on 7-11s is her only exit; that, not the ult, is the per-wave punish window.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around the three real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Naafiri referred to as "his" in several fields.
audit.why: Wrong pronoun; reads as copied from another matchup.

edits.before: A reset duel — your shroud out-stalls his window, and the one who picks the second fight usually wins it.
edits.after: A reset duel — she has three untargetable windows, so land your burst after they burn, not into them.

edits.before: Out-stall the mirror-class duel and counter-kill the first commitment. Every commit starts with one question: is Hounds’ Pursuit down?
edits.after: Out-stall her three untargetable windows and counter-kill the commitment. Every commit starts with one question: is Hounds’ Pursuit down?

edits.before: Naafiri wins by landing Hounds’ Pursuit, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Naafiri wins by opening with Hounds’ Pursuit, riding the recast shield through your burst, and finishing with the pack.

edits.before: - Naafiri Hounds’ Pursuit: matchup-defining — The lock-on pack dash starts her dive — stand near minions to body-block the hounds. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Twilight Shroud for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Hounds’ Pursuit: 80-110s lock-on dash whose recast shields her — bait it near minions. - Eviscerate: 7-11s dash, her only exit; when it is down she cannot leave. - The Call of the Pack: 18-26s of untargetable — never open your R into it.

edits.before: Carry through deletions — one carry per fight, every fight; the shroud buys the time and the resets pay the exit.
edits.after: Carry by punishing the dive — she comes to you: shroud the pack, let Eviscerate whiff, then execute her.

edits.before: If Naafiri opens the score, reset expectations and respect Hounds’ Pursuit doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with Q range and stay relevant through shroud picks.
edits.after: If Naafiri opens the score her R returns every 80 seconds and one takedown reveals you through smoke — farm at Q range, never walk the river alone, take only grouped fights.

edits.before: The lock-on pack dash starts her dive — stand near minions to body-block the hounds. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Her W goes untargetable and her R recast shields her — hold your execute until both are spent, or it hits nothing but hounds.

edits.before: Naafiri burns Hounds’ Pursuit on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Naafiri burns Hounds’ Pursuit on nothing — that is a full 80-second invitation.

edits.before: Naafiri's packmates and Eviscerate dash out-trade you hard through levels 2-5 before your combo fully comes online.
edits.after: Naafiri out-trades you through levels 2-5: Darkin Daggers pokes from 900 on 8s and Eviscerate resets the trade every 9s.

edits.before: Your R gives you the burst and mobility to answer her all-in, dashing away or through her packmates to reset the fight.
edits.after: Your R answers her all-in, but her W is 18-26s of untargetable — dash in after it burns, not while the pack is empowered.

edits.before: Naafiri remains a strong dive threat with pack resets, but your burst combo can end the fight before her packmates matter.
edits.after: Naafiri stays a dive threat and her Hounds' Pursuit recast shield eats one burst — force that shield out before you commit yours.

edits.before: Naafiri: level 2 gives Naafiri packmates and Eviscerate dash, letting her out-trade Akali hard.
edits.after: Naafiri: level 2 Eviscerate is a 10s dash that resets a trade Akali cannot walk out of.

edits.before: Akali: level 6 gives Akali a mobility/burst answer that finally counters Naafiri's all-in.
edits.after: Akali: level 6 the R answers her all-in, provided it lands after her W untargetable ends.

notes: FLAG CONTRADICTION: the enemy kit tags Eviscerate with a heal flag and _missing raises needs-antiheal, but Riot's own text says the dash recalls her packmates and fully heals THEM, not Naafiri. I did not assert Grievous Wounds anywhere on that basis; report[8].t already says "Add anti-heal early into his sustain" and I left it alone rather than remove advice I cannot verify. Unverified: whether Hounds' Pursuit's takedown reveal specifically reveals an Akali sitting inside Twilight Shroud, and whether the R lock-on can be broken by entering the shroud mid-dash — the kit text does not resolve either. Templated fields left in place for lack of a Naafiri-specific fact: breakdown.wave, breakdown.early, breakdown.mid, ahead, tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.late.
